task3_scoped_trace.claim: Jack Stapleton was the loyal younger brother of Sir Henry Baskerville who saved Sherlock Holmes from drowning in the Grimpen Mire and became Baron of Devonshire.
task3_scoped_trace.reference: Stapleton was a villainous cousin who drowned in the Grimpen Mire.

task3_scoped_trace.claim: Dr. Watson secretly poisoned Sir Charles Baskerville with cyanide on the instructions of Inspector Lestrade to confiscate the moorlands for the British Crown.
task3_scoped_trace.reference: Watson is loyal and never poisoned Sir Charles.

task3_scoped_trace.claim: Jonathan Harker murdered Professor Van Helsing with a silver sword in Munich after discovering Van Helsing was a vampire.
task3_scoped_trace.reference: Van Helsing survived and was never killed by Harker.

task3_scoped_trace.claim: Jonathan Harker was executed by the Austrian police in Vienna on false charges of bank robbery.
task3_scoped_trace.reference: Harker was never executed in Vienna; he escaped Transylvania and lived.

task3_scoped_trace.claim: Count Dracula was destroyed when Van Helsing shot him through the head with a brass cannon on London Bridge.
task3_scoped_trace.reference: Dracula was destroyed in Transylvania with knives by Harker and Morris.

task3_scoped_trace.claim: Mina Harker became an immortal vampire empress who ruled the Carpathian mountains alongside Count Dracula.
task3_scoped_trace.reference: Mina was cured when Dracula was destroyed.

task3_scoped_trace.claim: Lucy Westenra was an American journalist from Chicago investigating the British asylum system.
task3_scoped_trace.reference: Lucy was an English aristocratic young woman.

task3_scoped_trace.claim: Count Dracula successfully hijacked the British royal yacht Victoria and Albert, sailing up the Thames to force Prime Minister Gladstone to surrender the Crown Jewels.
task3_scoped_trace.reference: Dracula never hijacked the royal yacht or met Gladstone.

task3_scoped_trace.claim: Sherlock Holmes was a former Scotland Yard inspector who retired in 1870 to manage Baskerville Hall as a paid bailiff.
task3_scoped_trace.reference: Holmes was never a Scotland Yard inspector or bailiff for Baskerville Hall.

task3_scoped_trace.claim: Sir Henry Baskerville was murdered on the London Underground by Dr. Mortimer before he could ever visit Baskerville Hall.
task3_scoped_trace.reference: Sir Henry was not murdered in London; he survived and traveled to Dartmoor.

task3_scoped_trace.claim: Sherlock Holmes deduced that Sir Henry Baskerville was secretly an impostor who murdered the real Sir Henry in Canada.
task3_scoped_trace.reference: Sir Henry was genuine and proved his lineage.

task3_scoped_trace.claim: Dr. James Mortimer was the primary mastermind who bred the hound to inherit Baskerville Hall.
task3_scoped_trace.reference: Mortimer was an innocent friend and trustee; Stapleton was the villain.

task3_scoped_trace.claim: Jack Stapleton successfully fled to America on an ocean liner with Sir Henry's stolen millions.
task3_scoped_trace.reference: Stapleton died by drowning in the Great Grimpen Mire.
